description: Dewan Automotive Engineering Limited assembles and progressively manufactures tractors, light commercial vehicles and motorcycles, and trades in and manufactures the parts and implements that go with them. The company was incorporated in 1982, began operations in 1983, and is part of the Yousuf Dewan Companies.
headOffice: Dewan Centre, 3-A, Lalazar, Beach Luxury Hotel Road, Karachi 75350, Pakistan
